jsonLd.name: Hand Rejuvenation with Radiesse in Miami
jsonLd.description: Hand rejuvenation with Radiesse is an injectable treatment that restores lost volume on the dorsum of the hands using calcium hydroxylapatite, attenuating the visibility of tendons and veins while stimulating long-term collagen for firmer, more youthful-looking skin.

mainEntity.name: Is Radiesse approved for use on the hands?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Calcium hydroxylapatite, the active component of Radiesse, holds an FDA indication for the correction of volume loss in the dorsum of the hands. This is documented for the specific device. The indication recognises both the immediate volumising effect and the long-term collagen stimulation observed in this anatomical area when administered by qualified medical professionals.

mainEntity.name: How long do the results last on the hands?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most patients enjoy visible improvement for 12 to 18 months. Duration depends on metabolism, hand activity, sun exposure, the amount of product used, and skin condition. The hands move constantly and are exposed to UV light, so daily sunscreen and a yearly maintenance session help preserve volume and the collagen-related firming benefit obtained in the first treatment.

mainEntity.name: How is this different from PRP hand rejuvenation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Radiesse focuses on volume restoration and collagen scaffolding, while PRP focuses on cellular regeneration and skin-quality improvement. Radiesse refills the cushion over tendons and veins; PRP improves tone, fine wrinkles, and overall skin texture. Both treatments are complementary and many patients in Miami choose to combine them in a single layered plan personalised during consultation.

blocks.title: What it does for you
list: Restores volume on the dorsum of the hands in a single session, with improvement visible the same day.
Attenuates the visibility of extensor tendons and superficial veins through added subcutaneous cushioning.
Stimulates the patient's own collagen for progressive firming over the following months.
Improves the overall harmony between a youthful face and the appearance of the hands.
Offers long duration, with results that may last between 12 and 18 months in most patients.
Performed in a brief outpatient session with minimal downtime.
Can be combined with PRP, mesotherapy, or Fotona laser to address skin tone and texture in parallel.
